title: Move Don't Delete
style: 82 BPM warm acoustic indie folk pop, NZ AU vocal lean, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, soft analog synth pad bed, brushed snare, gentle upright bass, room reverb, intimate breathy male lead, layered group harmonies on chorus, doctrine track, slow build, hopeful and forgiving, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — fingerpicked acoustic, soft pad, room tone]
Move… don't delete
Move… don't delete
Every line you ever wrote — it's still got a seat

[Verse 1]
There's a folder in the corner called underscore-to-delete
Nothing in it ever gone, nothing under my feet
Just the old drafts breathing in a quieter room
Every one a witness, every one a bloom

The rage hits the keys and says wipe it all clean
But the rage don't know what the morning has seen
Wait the night, sleep the loop
In the morning the file's still part of the troop

[Pre-Chorus]
Delete is a door that swings one way
Move is a door that lets the work stay
The self of yesterday wrote that line
Give that self a softer sign

[Chorus]
Move — don't delete
Move — don't delete
Let the old line keep its seat
Move — don't delete
Nothing ever lost, nothing ever beat
Move — don't delete
Move — don't delete

[Verse 2]
Nunca se borra — never erased
Every byte of work a face
Every face a Tuesday self
Every Tuesday self deserves the shelf

Not the spotlight, not the stage
Just a quiet folder, just a page
But the page is breathing, the page is here
The page survived the year

[Pre-Chorus]
Delete is a door that swings one way
Move is a door that lets the work stay
The self of yesterday wrote that line
Give that self a softer sign

[Chorus]
Move — don't delete
Move — don't delete
Let the old line keep its seat
Move — don't delete
Nothing ever lost, nothing ever beat
Move — don't delete
Move — don't delete

[Bridge — stripped, half-spoken]
The past self isn't an enemy.
The past self is the witness.
Move the file. Keep the line.
The stack stays alive when the stack stays kind.

[Final Chorus — lifted, harmonies open]
Move — don't delete
Move — don't delete
Let the old line keep its seat
Move — don't delete
Nothing ever lost, nothing ever beat
Move — don't delete
Move — don't delete

[Outro]
Nunca se borra…
Never erased…
Move… don't delete
Every line still has a face
336 — still ringing
